high_judgments.finding: ComposeItem::Internal with an unknown alias is a silent no-op, leaving the intended action public
high_judgments.reason: Unknown alias/action pairs are inserted without validation and only exact matches suppress actions, contradicting the documented error contract.

high_judgments.finding: Lvalue rewrite ignores bound when a binder shadows a component state
high_judgments.reason: The claim assumes a forall binder is a mutable lvalue; the source instead treats lvalues as component-state assignment targets.

observed_result: 8bit/high completed under the 1200-second policy and produced one actionable finding out of two. Its blind-judge actionability rate was higher than 8bit/low and 4bit/low in these replicates, but lower than the single-finding 8bit/medium result.
interpretation_ceiling: Actionability rate is a blind-judge proxy, not ground-truth precision. Each arm has one stochastic run and only one to three findings. The arms chose different third projections, no gold defect universe exists for recall, and medium required a separate final retry. Stable accuracy or an intrinsic effort ordering cannot be inferred.
